reviewer.scope: Optional standalone job3337 read-only observer template and its directly extracted observer dependency; no training/control/binding changes reviewed or authorized.

static_checks.result: The template contains an unused local import of the existing control module. Its current import-time scope reads local route configuration and defines functions; the guarded CLI main, retired-route transport, credential synchronization and probe functions are not invoked. This import is distinct from the old3332 script, which is never imported. No model or candidate is imported remotely.

The old file is parsed as AST and only its literal code assignment is extracted. Its old route construction and executable top-level calls are not imported or executed. The extracted query/read code is retargeted from3332 to3337.

The extracted remote observer only queries scheduler/queue and GPU compute telemetry, reads matching run metadata and bounded log tails, and prints JSON. There is no model/candidate import, GPU computation, signal, job submission/cancellation, remote file write/deletion or credential operation.

The3337 additions only read metadata and original Ray main-task log heads/tails plus file identity/size/time. They do not attach to Ray or modify live processes, trainer state, buffers, probability rules or counters.

Remote Python uses an empty environment and -E -B -S, and the route uses the retained18 public configuration with explicit identity selection, batch mode, strict host-key checking, no host-key updates and single connection attempt. Credentials are referenced for existing SSH authentication only; none are rewritten or synchronized.

Only a new local observation report is created with exclusive mode x. OBSERVATION_TAG must be substituted with a unique filename tag before each later use. Any observation/transport/parse failure exits this standalone reader; it has no linkage that pauses or gates healthy3337 training.

non_blocking_observations.observation: The SSH options are strict, while the exact gateway/IP/identity values are read from the retained18 public configuration. This template does not itself pin those three values to the once-control constants; review does not claim that an arbitrary changed configuration retains the same endpoints. Root reports actual h100-8 hostname observations twice; this reviewer did not execute an additional observation. The accepted V1 template stays unchanged and this dependency is not a training blocker.
